tiptap_prose_fix.description: Critical fix for TipTap rich text content. Solves the 'paragrafi attaccati' bug.
tiptap_prose_fix.css_rules: .ProseMirror p { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.75; } .ProseMirror h1, .ProseMirror h2, .ProseMirror h3, .ProseMirror h4 { margin-top: 2rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0f172a; line-height: 1.2; } .ProseMirror ul { list-style-type: disc; padding-left: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; } .ProseMirror ol { list-style-type: decimal; padding-left: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; } .ProseMirror blockquote { border-left: 4px solid #004587; padding-left: 1rem; font-style: italic; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; background-color: #f8fafc; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 0 0.375rem 0.375rem 0; } .ProseMirror img { border-radius: 0.375rem; margin-top: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; width: 100%; height: auto; } .ProseMirror:focus { outline: none; }

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-button').
accessibility.contrast: Text over hero images meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio using the defined hero_overlay. The primary blue #004587 against white provides strong contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do not use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk. Explicitly import and use 'Outfit' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body from Google Fonts.
2. Strict usage of the Official Logos provided in the /public/brand/ folder. Do not use text placeholders for logos. Ensure they are sized appropriately (e.g., h-12 to h-16 in header).
3. Apply the 'tiptap_prose_fix.css_rules' directly into your index.css or a dedicated editor.css to ensure user-generated articles have proper spacing, fixing the 'paragrafi attaccati' bug.
4. Ensure the Admin UI is visually distinct but conceptually aligned: use a sidebar layout, crisp borders, solid table structures. Maintain the navy blue primary color for active states.
5. Follow the Bento Grid protocol for public pages: asymmetrical where marketing, dense and structured for tabular data (Associates/Designations).
6. Hero section overlay must be a gradient from deep navy to transparent, never a flat #000000 overlay. Refer to visual_enhancers.hero_overlay.
7. Do NOT invent colors (NO purples, NO teals). Stick strictly to Blu istituzionale (#004587) e blu secondario (#003366), Gold (#D4AF37), White, and Slate variations.
8. Emojis as icons are BANNED. Use lucide-react exclusively.
